name: weftcut-site
description: Marketing homepage for WeftCut — static, zero-dependency

scripts.build: node build-i18n.mjs && node build-md.mjs && node build-sitemap.mjs
scripts.check: node build-i18n.mjs --check && node build-md.mjs --check && node build-sitemap.mjs --check
scripts.preview: npm run dist && npx --yes wrangler@4 dev
scripts.deploy: npm run dist && npx --yes wrangler@4 deploy
